What am i doing wrong? The same thing happens when the houses (yes they're houses) are placed above the grass, the left and right (higher and upper) tiles of the sprite removes the grass.  Thanks in advice

posts.author: MiguelRPG
posts.body:
There are 4 tile layers, but only two can be used with tilesets that go from tab B to E.
The correct option is to use autotiles for the ground and grass, which are A2 tiles, then you will have 2 layers for elements, which could be your tree.
To learn how to create your own tiles:
https://www.rpgmakerweb.com/blog/classic-tutorial-making-an-autotile
https://www.rpgmakerweb.com/blog/making-a-custom-grass-autotile-from-scratch
https://www.rpgmakerweb.com/blog/classic-tutorial-how-autotiles-work
You will see that autotiles as they are, have been a great asset of RPG Maker since RPG Maker VX. I really like.
